definitions.label: Auto-archive after (new agency)
definitions.description: Months without activity after which the daily lifecycle run archives a client: the value a new agency starts with, and the window of an agency with no settings row.

definitions.label: Auto-archive: longest an owner may set
definitions.description: The longest auto-archive window an agency owner may set on Settings > Data and privacy (inside the database bounds 12 to 120 months).

definitions.label: Auto-archive: shortest an owner may set
definitions.description: The shortest auto-archive window an agency owner may set on Settings > Data and privacy (inside the database bounds 12 to 120 months).

definitions.label: Discount owner limit of a new agency
definitions.description: A proposal discount above this percent needs the owner's approval. The value a new agency starts with (the owner changes it on Settings > Pricing, 0 to 100 %).

definitions.label: Retail markup ceiling
definitions.description: The highest default retail markup an agency owner may set per AA product type on Settings > Retail markup (from 0 %).

definitions.label: Book now price checks of a new agency
definitions.description: Book now price checks a minute an agency's page takes from every address together: the value a new agency starts with, and the ceiling of an agency with no settings row.

definitions.label: Book now price checks: highest an owner may set
definitions.description: The highest Book now price checks a minute an agency owner may set on Settings > Online booking (inside the database bounds 10 to 600).

definitions.label: Book now price checks: lowest an owner may set
definitions.description: The lowest Book now price checks a minute an agency owner may set on Settings > Online booking (inside the database bounds 10 to 600).

definitions.label: Trash window of a new agency
definitions.description: Days a deleted record stays restorable before the daily lifecycle run purges it: the value a new agency starts with, and the window of an agency with no settings row.

definitions.label: Trash window: longest an owner may set
definitions.description: The longest trash window an agency owner may set on Settings > Data and privacy (inside the database bounds 1 to 30 days).

definitions.label: Trash window: shortest an owner may set
definitions.description: The shortest trash window an agency owner may set on Settings > Data and privacy (inside the database bounds 1 to 30 days).

definitions.label: AI budget of a new agency
definitions.description: The monthly AI budget a new agency starts with, and the budget of an agency that has no settings row yet. Never above the agency's ceiling (the lower of the two applies).

definitions.label: AI budget ceiling per agency
definitions.description: The highest monthly AI budget an agency owner may set on Settings > AI (AA pays for the calls). An administrator may give one agency its own ceiling. Seeded at 2 USD (the old code default).

definitions.label: AI draft reply output token cap
definitions.description: Output token cap of every route entry of the crm_draft_reply stage (the only CRM AI stage that writes text); a reply cut at the cap is logged truncated and the draft says reply by hand. Seeded at 800 (the old Terraform and code value).

definitions.label: Overdue invoice reminder every
definitions.description: Days between two reminders of one overdue invoice to the trip owner (the first is the day after the due date). The CRM never writes to the client by itself; the agent chases.

definitions.label: Overdue invoice reminders at most
definitions.description: Reminders one overdue invoice gives the trip owner at most; 0 stops the reminders.

definitions.label: Refund owner-approval threshold of a new agency
definitions.description: A refund or cancellation-fee change above this amount (in the agency's base currency) needs the owner; an agent approves up to it. The value a new agency starts with, and the threshold of an agency with no settings row.

definitions.label: AI calls per agency per minute
definitions.description: CRM AI gateway calls one agency makes per minute; above it a call is refused rate_limited before anything is scrubbed or paid. 0 turns the limit off. Seeded from the code default (6).

definitions.label: Submissions per inquiry form per hour
definitions.description: Submissions one inquiry form (and the Book now bookings of its key) takes per hour whatever the address, charged only after every other check; 0 turns the quota off. An administrator may give a busy agency its own quota. Seeded from Terraform (200).

definitions.label: Inquiry form and client page writes per address
definitions.description: Inquiry-form submissions and every anonymous client-page write (proposal page, sign-in code, Book now booking, hold, accept, pay) per client address per minute; 0 turns the limit off. Seeded from Terraform (5).

definitions.label: Requests per member per agency
definitions.description: Requests one member makes to /crm/v1 for one agency per minute (429 rate_limited above it), the same for every plan; 0 turns the limit off. Seeded from the code default (600; Terraform does not set it).

definitions.label: Public routes per address
definitions.description: Requests per client address per minute on the unauthenticated /crm/public routes and the health routes; 0 turns the limit off. Seeded from the Terraform value in force (60; the code default was 120).

definitions.label: Audit partition drop: dry run
definitions.description: On: the daily audit retention only reports the monthly audit partitions past 12 months it would drop (both Object Lock copies stay). Off drops them, but only while Terraform's AUDIT_RETENTION_DRY_RUN floor is off too.

definitions.label: Job row retention: dry run
definitions.description: On: the daily crm_job_retention run only counts the finished crm.job rows it would delete. Off deletes them, but only while Terraform's JOB_RETENTION_DRY_RUN floor is off too.

definitions.label: Lifecycle deletes: dry run
definitions.description: On: every hard delete of agency data (submission redaction, LLM-call purge, trash purge, auto-archive, an owner's erasure or offboarding erase) only counts. Off lets them run, but only while Terraform's LIFECYCLE_DRY_RUN floor is off too (two keys: Terraform keeps a hard never-delete floor, tech lead S279 Q7).

definitions.label: Unused partner account clean-up: dry run
definitions.description: On: the partner-account clean-up only counts the never-used partner pool accounts it would delete. Off deletes them while Terraform's PARTNER_ACCOUNT_CLEANUP_DRY_RUN floor is off (it is today). Seeded off: today's effective value.

definitions.label: Two-person approval of CRM settings
definitions.description: On: a maker-checker CRM setting needs a second AA staff member to approve. Off (dev phase, tech lead S279 Q2): the administrator may approve their own change with a reason, and a high-impact change e-mails AA ops. Turn on at the first prod or paying tenant. This flag is maker-checker itself: while it is on, turning it off needs a second person.
